acceptanceCriteria: Delivered spec-first: numbered owner-accepted requirements in the owning spec (application-map-v0, application-navigation-ledger-v0 or application-flow-understanding-v1), with focused tests or measured evidence tracing each.
Missing or unresolvable evidence yields an explicit UNKNOWN, abstention or full-suite fallback, never invented certainty; read commands stay read-only, local and offline.
body:
Competitor/source: Angular lazy loading https://angular.dev/guide/routing/loading-strategies , Vue Router https://router.vuejs.org/guide/ .

Gap: the AMAP-V0 non-goals name Vue/Angular router dialects as follow-ups, but no ticket exists (deduped against V1-1131, V1-1169).

Proposal: route-object dialects that follow lazy loadChildren/loadComponent import() to the loaded module and join it through the TJAA import graph. Injected or computed loaders stay UNKNOWN. Report: scratchpad appmap-competitive-research.md (2026-10-10 competitive research).
title: appmap: Vue Router and Angular Router dialects following loadChildren/loadComponent import()
